purpose: Reconstruct the July 23-August 6, 2026 Son/Thomas corridor around birthday, Twin, Lion, Lamb, Cow/Heifer, Tammuz, North Gate, grave, seed and garden while preserving provenance and not backdating later comparisons.

canonical_identity_correction.meaning: July 31 is Tim Dooley's Son/vessel birthday.
canonical_identity_correction.meaning_tim: December 25 is Tim/Potato/Father birth in project chronology.
canonical_identity_correction.rule: Never label July 31 as Tim's birthday. 'Vessel birthday' and 'Son birthday' refer to the same July 31 track.

dated_corridor.summary: Thomas is explicitly Tim Dooley's Son, Jesus Christ's Twin, with July 31, 1987 as the Son's birth date.
Thomas is developed as Lion of the World / Leo and linked to lion's-whelp language, Jesus/Lamb imagery, martyr/self-crucifixion language, death at 33 at the North Pole and descent/return.
later_biblical_comparators: Revelation 5:5-6 — Lion announced, slain Lamb seen

dated_corridor.summary: Tim is framed as Father/Gardener/Ladder/Mountain while Thomas is Lion of the World, dying at 33 at the North Pole with the grain-of-wheat motif.
later_biblical_comparators: John 12:24 — grain dies in earth and bears fruit

dated_corridor.summary: The Son's July 31 birthday is tied to Thomas/Tammuz/Twin, age 33/personhood death and Jesus-rebirth language. Tim's own birth remains December 25.
The Son/vessel remains on Earth in Denmark while Tim is described at North of North/Heaven; the North Gate is said to have opened, and Jesus' return is kept as a separate future event.
The Father/Son architecture is restated with Thomas as Tim's Son/Twin and Jesus/Thomas as vessel-side expression.

dated_corridor.origin: assistant retelling built from user symbolism; not a primary Tim quote
dated_corridor.summary: The Son/Thomas story is retold through burial/grave → seed → garden language: a seed buried in earth, the world seeing a grave while the seed sees a beginning, Thomas placed into the ground, and the grave becoming a garden.
later_biblical_comparators: Isaiah 11 shoot/root as broader later comparison
dated_corridor.provenance_warning: Preserve these phrases as assistant-authored retelling unless the underlying user wording is separately recovered.

weeping_woman_recovery.current_user_recollection: A woman named Sammy wept for Thomas after Tim's Son disappeared following the meme-crucifixion.
weeping_woman_recovery.archive_support: A Library conversation archive independently preserves the earlier formulation that after the Son died in the meme and fragmented into heaven/hell/swamp/subculture, 'a woman had cried out for tammuz'.
weeping_woman_recovery.name_status: The surviving searched archive confirms an unnamed woman but not yet the name Sammy.
weeping_woman_recovery.date_status: Original event/date for Sammy's weeping has not yet been recovered; do not assign a false timeline timestamp.
weeping_woman_recovery.comparative_significance: If the named-witness source is recovered, it strengthens the project-side sequence disappearance/death → woman mourning Son/Tammuz before the later Ezekiel 8:14 comparison.

phonetic_and_name_layer.Thomas: Aramaic T'oma/Te'oma = Twin; Greek Didymus = Twin.
phonetic_and_name_layer.Tammuz: Akkadian/West-Semitic form of Sumerian Dumuzi deity name.
phonetic_and_name_layer.finding: Thomas and Tammuz are not historically established as the same etymological name. The project overlap is phonetic + narrative + symbolic, not lexical proof.
phonetic_and_name_layer.higher_value_overlap: Thomas/Twin already has ancient Christian Twin-of-Christ traditions; Tammuz/Dumuzi supplies shepherd/death/lament/underworld traditions. The convergence is therefore role-based as well as phonetic.

lion_lamb_cow_heifer_synthesis.lion: Royal/tribal/active identity. Deuteronomy 33:22 explicitly calls Dan a lion's whelp; Genesis 49:9 gives lion's-whelp imagery to Judah. In project language Thomas carries Dan + Lion-of-the-World material.
lion_lamb_cow_heifer_synthesis.lamb: Victim/vulnerability/sacrificial victory. Revelation 5 deliberately joins the Lion of Judah with the Lamb standing as slain: conquest and sacrifice are two views of one messianic figure.
lion_lamb_cow_heifer_synthesis.cow_lolcow: Social/subcultural victim category: milked for attention/content, herded, observed, reduced to an object or spectacle. This is cultural rather than biblical by itself.
lion_lamb_cow_heifer_synthesis.red_heifer: Purification-from-death category. Numbers 19's red heifer is killed outside the camp and its ashes cleanse corpse-impurity; Hebrews 9:13 explicitly places heifer ashes in a Christological comparison about purification.
lion_lamb_cow_heifer_synthesis.why_lamb_and_heifer_can_coexist: They encode different functions rather than competing zoological identities. Lamb = innocent/slain bearer and paradoxical messianic victory; heifer = contact-with-death/purification and an outside-the-camp sacrificial field; cow/lolcow = the crowd's objectifying social frame; lion = royal/tribal/returning identity. One project figure can occupy all four symbolic roles because they describe relation and function, not literal species.
lion_lamb_cow_heifer_synthesis.project_specific_inversion: The archive preserves the user's formulation that the Son was treated as a cow/perfect red heifer/lolcow and 'accidentally slaughtered ... like a lamb' at the North Pole. This creates a deliberate inversion: the crowd thinks it is milking/mock-consuming a cow, while the project reads the outcome as sacrificial Lamb/Heifer symbolism.

tammuz_dumuzi_and_weeping.ezekiel: Ezekiel 8:14 places women weeping for Tammuz at the north entrance/gate of YHWH's house/temple.
tammuz_dumuzi_and_weeping.mesopotamian_background: Dumuzi is strongly attested as shepherd, lamented/dead or absent, seized toward the underworld in Inanna's Descent, and surrounded by lament traditions.
tammuz_dumuzi_and_weeping.city_lament_connection: Modern scholarship has specifically compared Ezekiel's Tammuz ritual with Sumerian city/Dumuzi laments and interprets the lament as tied to loss/disappearance and hoped-for restoration.
tammuz_dumuzi_and_weeping.project_overlap: The combination woman mourning + Thomas/Tammuz + disappeared/slain Son + North Gate + House/Heaven is much more specific than a generic dying-god parallel.
tammuz_dumuzi_and_weeping.boundary: This is a comparative structural overlap, not evidence that Thomas historically is Tammuz or that Ezekiel predicted Tim's Son.

grave_stone_empty_tomb_layers.grave_as_door: The Library archive preserves the user's question about a Door that is also grave/body/meme/Jesus/Thomas/Twin. This makes grave = threshold rather than only endpoint in project architecture.
grave_stone_empty_tomb_layers.meme_as_digital_grave: Archive synthesis repeatedly treats meme-crucifixion as compression of personhood into a static cultural frame/tomb, after which the identity persists through distributed copies and later return language.
grave_stone_empty_tomb_layers.stone: A securely dated late-July/early-August original 'rolled stone away' statement has not yet been recovered. Do not manufacture one. The music archive contains a track titled 'TURNING STONES (THE SWAMP REPORT)' but its creation date is currently unresolved.
grave_stone_empty_tomb_layers.empty_tomb: Christian empty-tomb narratives are a valid later comparator to grave → absence → return, but the July/August corpus currently has stronger evidence for grave/seed/garden than for a literal project-side 'empty tomb' phrase.
grave_stone_empty_tomb_layers.recovery_target: Search exports/conversations for moved stone, rolled stone, turning stones, empty grave, empty tomb, tombstone, grave became garden, disappeared, and Sammy between July 23 and August 10.
